title: Chapter 329 The Illusion Test
content:
Chapter 329 The Illusion Test

Seeing that the people below have quieted down, and their faces are changing, they are obviously thinking about the conditions they just mentioned.

Many of them did not expect that Zhong Yu would fight with them like this.

The test, only after passing the test can one learn the real magic method, and the rest of the people have all become non-staff personnel who are generally doing odd jobs.

Many people were outraged by the ordeal, seeing it as a humiliation for them.

Those who feel humiliated are the samurai or members of the local powerful families in Yamamoto County.

They may think that they are powerful and a real warrior, different from those untouchables.

Or think that you are born noble, and letting yourself be screened with those untouchables is an insult to your identity.

And they have deeper worries in their hearts.

They are scared.

Yes, just scared.

If they pass the test, that's fine, everyone's happy.

But if they didn't pass the test, were screened out, and were surpassed by those untouchables who looked down on them, how would this make them feel ashamed, and how would it make them feel happy.

If this news is passed back, it will greatly shake their status in the family.

Many people felt guilty at this moment, especially those warrior nobles, their hearts were shaken. They dare not take the risk of losing face and ruining their reputation.

Ever since, hula la.

Out of the thousands of people in the hall, more than 200 people left immediately.

Among them are those powerful children, and there are also those warriors who cannot be insulted. There are also some untouchables who are psychologically discouraged when they hear that they need to be screened.

However, Zhong Yu didn't stop these people from leaving at all, not even a little bit of fluctuation, just let them leave.

Zhong Yu's inaction disappointed many people, especially those who were leaving.

They originally had such an idea in their hearts, maybe the owner of this dojo saw so many people leaving, and would retain them out of consideration.

Then open a special channel for these powerful children and warriors, these noble people.

But they were doomed to be disappointed. Then, under the gazes of countless people, they walked away despondently, taking with them endless resentment and anger.

After the more than 200 people left, the crowded crowd on the square suddenly thinned out, and there was still a big gap between them.

Among them, there were nearly a hundred warriors, but more than 70 of them left. These warriors from various families had their own fiefs and honors, and they could not allow themselves to be treated the same as these untouchables, so they left.

There are also those powerful children who think they are aristocrats, and they can't agree that they stand together with the untouchables under their hands and receive the same treatment, so they also left.

All of a sudden, most of the spies who originally came from various powerful forces left, leaving only a small number of people.

The remaining more than 30 samurai are mostly wild samurai who wandered and no one took them in.

Many of the ancestors of these wild samurai were originally samurai canonized by various families. However, it has been passed down to their generation, and they have completely declined, and there is no longer any family that employs them.

So they began to wander around, chasing war corners, wherever there is war, there are them.

They accept the employment of various families on the battlefield, so as to make contributions, in anticipation of becoming an official warrior with a territory.

Of course, there are still a few swordsmen who purely pursue strength, pursue the way of the sword, travel around, and hone themselves.

These people have the deepest desire for power.

Similarly, there are still a large number of untouchables below who are eager to change their humble fate and become masters like warriors in one fell swoop.

Many of them will definitely give everything and do all kinds of crazy things when they face the opportunity to change their destiny.

Of course, more people will face these dangers, and they will be afraid, so they will shrink back, and they will be the mud that they can't support the wall.

He glanced at these people, stared down at them, and swept over their faces one by one, causing many people to lower their heads involuntarily, not daring to look at each other.

But there were also some people who went straight up to meet Zhong Yu's eyes sharply.

"Since the irrelevant people have left, the test will begin immediately."

Zhong Yu looked at the people left behind, and felt that they were all good-natured, at least 200 people could meet the standard.

However, whether the dragon is a worm or not, whether they can stay or not depends on waiting for them to pass the test.

Zhong Yu quickly pinched the seals one by one with his hands, and as his fingertips swiped, a wonderful figure appeared in front of his hands.

Then, mysterious lines appeared on the ground of the square. These lines are connected in series to form a mysterious formation.

Under the traction of the Yin Jue swiped by Zhong Yu's fingertips, the formation suddenly radiated so much that it even blocked the light of the sun for a while, and quickly enveloped everyone in the square.

When the light completely enveloped these people, they thought of such a thought in their hearts.

"It turns out that this lord is not only a warrior, but also an onmyoji with profound cultivation."

Then all of these people's eyes went black, and all kinds of fantasies that appeared in their minds fell into the maze that Zhong Yu had set up for them.

They will accept the illusion test set by Zhong Yu in the labyrinth, in which they will experience various choices. And these choices, without exception, are all tests of whether they will advance or retreat in the face of killing.

In this illusion, whether it is a warrior or a coward, a good man or a butcher, will be revealed in every detail.

Those who meet Zhong Yu's conditions will sink deeper and deeper into this illusion, and the longer they are deluded by the illusion, the deeper their desire for power will be, and the easier it will be to be controlled.

And if they exited the illusion and were awakened shortly after entering the illusion, it meant that they did not have a killing heart and were not suitable for Zhong Yu's path at all, so they were naturally eliminated.

As for the onmyoji they just mentioned, it is a rather peculiar profession in Japan.

This profession specializes in subduing demons and eliminating demons, and also part-time worships gods. Its functions are probably similar to Chinese Taoist priests, but many aspects have been weakened on a large scale.

Onmyoji was originally a profession formed by the Japanese who learned a little bit of Chinese Taoism, and then brought it back to Japan to evolve.

But even this superficiality, in the eyes of many people in Japan, is still a shocking ability, which deeply awes the Japanese.

So it's normal for them to be surprised that Zhong Yu knows both the swordsmanship of a warrior and the spells of the Yin Yang family.

After all, throughout Japanese history, it is not uncommon for people to practice Yin Yang and swordsmanship.

But it is very rare to be able to cultivate both of them to such a high level at the same time, and there have been few people since ancient times.

But these few people, without exception, are all big men with overarching cultivation bases. The school has been passed down for a lifetime, and it is still extremely prosperous until now. They can't help but become more curious and longing for the beauty of Zhong Yu's skills. .

There are even some people in their hearts who regard Zhong Yu as one of those big men who will become one of them in the future, the difference is only time.
